items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Butch, I think they called her Butch. She used to call me Newly all the time.

ctx.x: I think she died very young.
Butch, I think they called her Butch. She used to call me Newly all the time.
I never will forget her, very cute, petite and cute. She died I think up in Detroit... She was so nice. In those days, you know, everybody was so nice.
